# Resource: catalyst_auth_user_role

Assign an existing application end-user to an existing role through the official SDK's user-update API. Requires ZohoCatalyst.projects.users.READ and .UPDATE. Experimental: no disposable application user was available for live write verification; offline lifecycle tests do not establish live compatibility. Does not invite/delete users, provision roles, configure authentication, or edit table permissions. Destroy assigns the explicit destroy_role_id fallback; it never deletes the user. Use one resource/state per project/user across all tools because each user has one role and Catalyst provides no conditional role update. User profiles are not stored in state. Import as project_id/user_id/destroy_role_id; import only reads the current assignment.

~> **Note:** This experimental resource has offline verification only. It assigns
an existing end-user to an existing role. Destroy assigns the configured fallback
role; it does not delete the user or configure login/permissions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "project_id" { type = string }
variable "user_id" { type = string }
variable "role_id" { type = string }
variable "fallback_role_id" { type = string }

# Experimental: existing application end-user and roles are prerequisites.
# This resource does not configure login, create roles or edit permissions.
resource "catalyst_auth_user_role" "example" {
  project_id      = var.project_id
  user_id         = var.user_id
  role_id         = var.role_id
  destroy_role_id = var.fallback_role_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Argument Reference

### Required

- `destroy_role_id` (String) Existing fallback role assigned on destroy. Choose a least-privilege role such as App User. Apply changes to this value before destroying. Updating this field alone does not change user access.
- `project_id` (String) Existing project's positive numeric ID as a string. Changes require replacement.
- `role_id` (String) Existing role to assign. Changes update the user's role in place.
- `user_id` (String) Existing end-user's positive numeric ID as a string. Administrator/collaborator accounts are refused. Changes require replacement.

## Attribute Reference

- `id` (String) Assignment identity: project_id/user_id.
- `role_name` (String) Current assigned role name reported by Catalyst.

## Import

Use the same provider data center, organization and environment as the existing
resource. Import reads the object into state; review the next plan before apply.

### Import Command

```shell
# project_id/user_id/destroy_role_id; import reads the current assignment.
# The fallback role is assigned when this resource is later destroyed.
terraform import catalyst_auth_user_role.example 12345678901234567/23456789012345678/34567890123456789
```
